SADIE II Database, D1 (KU100), version 2-2
Copyright 2018 University of York.

This product includes modified data developed at the AudioLab, Department of
Electronic Engineering, University of York, United Kingdom, by Callum Armstrong,
Lewis Thresh and Gavin Kearney as part of the SADIE Project.

Source dataset: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.12092466
Source paper: https://doi.org/10.3390/app8112029
Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0; see SADIE-II-LICENSE.txt.

Modifications by Protocodus for Maremba: directional interpolation for a fixed
virtual recording scene; minimum-phase reconstruction; finite filter windowing
and float conversion; extraction of residual interaural delay; resampling for
supported rendering rates. The original measurements are diffuse-field
equalized and low-frequency extended. These filters are not a claim of an
exact microphone replica, individualized hearing, or absolute SPL calibration.

KU100 identifies the measured hardware. No affiliation or endorsement by its
manufacturer or the University of York is implied.
